note: Family campground on 55 rural acres off US 151 near Dodgeville, on an open hillside with scattered trees above a pasture and a trout stream. A rustic miner's cabin is rented. Dirt bikes are not allowed. --Claude
summary: Operator site (home, rates, about, contact), RV Life ($$, 60 sites), Google 4.7 (149) and imagery read. Not waterfront. Pin OK.
